distributionZh: 岷山、邛崃山、大相岭、小相岭、秦岭六大山系，海拔1200–3400米的竹林。
distributionEn: Six mountain systems from Minshan to Qinling, in bamboo forest at 1200–3400 m.
habitatZh: 亚高山针叶林下的竹林
habitatEn: Subalpine conifer forest with bamboo understorey
descriptionZh: 从“濒危”降级为“易危”的旗舰物种。每天进食十余公斤竹子，拇指状的腕骨专司握竹。全国野生种群约1900只。
descriptionEn: The flagship species downlisted from Endangered to Vulnerable. Eating over 10 kg of bamboo daily, it grips stalks with a pseudo-thumb; some 1,900 remain in the wild.
threatZh: 栖息地片段化、竹子开花周期
threatEn: Habitat fragmentation and bamboo flowering cycles

distributionZh: 四川西部、秦岭与神农架的高山针叶林。
distributionEn: High conifer forests of western Sichuan, the Qinling range and Shennongjia.
descriptionZh: 身披金色长毛、面庞湛蓝的“雪山隐士”，是社会性最强的灵长类之一，冬季结成两三百只的大群抱团取暖。
descriptionEn: A blue-faced 'hermit of the snow mountains' wrapped in golden fur; highly social, troops of several hundred huddle together through winter.
threatZh: 森林砍伐、栖息地岛屿化

distributionZh: 青藏高原及周边高山，中国拥有全球最大的雪豹种群。
distributionEn: The Tibetan Plateau and bordering ranges; China holds the world's largest population.
descriptionZh: “雪山之王”拥有可裹住全身的长尾平衡器与放大脚掌雪地靴。红外相机的普及让人类第一次看清了它的隐秘生活。
descriptionEn: The 'ghost of the mountains' balances on a tail as long as its body, with oversized paws working as snowshoes. Camera traps are finally revealing its secret life.
threatZh: 盗猎、人兽冲突、猎物减少
threatEn: Poaching, human-wildlife conflict and prey loss

distributionZh: 长白山与完达山林海，与俄罗斯远东种群相连。
distributionEn: Forests of Changbai and Wanda, linked to the Russian Far East population.
descriptionZh: 现存最大的猫科动物，一掌可碎鹿颅。东北虎豹国家公园成立后，境内种群从个位数回升至50只以上。
descriptionEn: The largest living cat, capable of crushing a deer's skull. Since the Northeast Tiger and Leopard Park was established, the resident population has rebounded from single digits to over 50.
threatEn: Habitat loss and poaching of prey

distributionZh: 西双版纳、普洱约40年来种群翻番，并向北活动到昆明边缘。
distributionEn: Xishuangbanna and Pu'er; numbers have doubled in four decades, ranging north to the edge of Kunming.
habitatEn: Tropical rainforest and valley monsoon forest
descriptionZh: 中国最后的野生象群，如今约300头。2021年“短鼻家族”北上南归之旅，让全民围观了一场生动的保护课。
descriptionEn: China's last wild elephants, now around 300. In 2021 the famous northward trek and return of one herd gave the nation a live lesson in conservation.

distributionZh: 华南丘陵的常绿阔叶林，种群较历史下降九成以上。
distributionEn: Evergreen hill forests of southern China; numbers down over 90% from historical levels.
descriptionZh: 身披鳞甲的“森林卫士”，一只每年吃掉约7000万只白蚁与蚂蚁。2020年升为国家一级保护并移出药典，保护级别史无前例地提速。
descriptionEn: An armour-plated forest guardian consuming some 70 million ants and termites a year. In 2020 it was upgraded to first-class protection and removed from the pharmacopoeia.

distributionZh: 长江中下游干流及洞庭、鄱阳两湖，约1200头。
distributionEn: The middle-lower Yangtze and its two great lakes, about 1,200 individuals.
descriptionZh: 嘴角天生上扬的“微笑天使”，长江最后的鲸类。十年禁渔后鱼类资源回升，2022年普查显示种群首次止跌回升。
descriptionEn: The 'smiling angel' of the Yangtze and the river's last cetacean. After a decade fishing ban, the 2022 survey recorded the first population recovery.
threatZh: 航运、渔业误捕、水工工程

distributionZh: 羌塘、可可西里、阿尔金山三大保护区，种群恢复至约30万只。
distributionEn: The Changtang, Hoh Xil and Altun reserves; recovered to some 300,000 animals.
habitatZh: 海拔4000米以上高原荒漠草原
descriptionZh: 从“濒危”降为“近危再到无危”的成功典范。每年数万头雌羚迁徙产羔，是地球上最壮观的陆生迁徙之一。
descriptionEn: A conservation success story, downlisted all the way to Least Concern. The annual calving migration of tens of thousands of females remains one of Earth's great overland spectacles.
threatZh: 历史上的盗猎已基本遏制

distributionZh: 环青海湖草原，为中国特有羚羊。
distributionEn: Grasslands around Qinghai Lake; a gazelle endemic to China.
descriptionZh: 屁股上有一块心形白斑的“高原精灵”。曾因围栏与狼害跌至不足300只，如今保护行动使其回升至3000头左右。
descriptionEn: The 'plateau sprite' wears a heart-shaped white rump. Fencing and wolves once cut it below 300 animals; conservation has rebuilt the herd to about 3,000.

distributionZh: 高黎贡山中段，国内不足150只。
distributionEn: Central Gaoligong Mountains; fewer than 150 remain in China.
descriptionZh: 2017年才定名的新物种，名字致敬《星球大战》中的“天行者”。一夫一妻家庭清晨合唱，歌声可传两公里。
descriptionEn: Described as recently as 2017 and named after the Star Wars Skywalkers. Monogamous families greet the dawn with duets carrying two kilometres.
threatEn: Habitat fragmentation and a tiny population

distributionZh: 中蒙边境的戈壁与荒漠草原。
distributionEn: Gobi and desert steppe along the China-Mongolia border.
descriptionZh: 耐渴能力惊人，可数日不饮水。蹄声如鼓、奔跑如风，是荒漠生态系统健康的指示物种。
descriptionEn: Astonishingly drought-hardy, it can go days without drinking. Drumming hooves across the gravel plains signal a healthy desert ecosystem.

distributionZh: 北方草原与高原的碎石坡地。
distributionEn: Rocky steppe and plateau scree across the north and west.
descriptionZh: 一脸“又气又丧”的表情包顶流。绒毛是猫科中最密者之一，可抵御零下40度严寒；瞳孔收缩时呈圆形而非竖线。
descriptionEn: The internet's grumpiest cat. Its fur is among the densest of any felid, good for −40 °C, and its pupils shrink to circles rather than slits.
threatZh: 毒鼠药二次中毒、猎物减少
threatEn: Secondary rodenticide poisoning and prey decline

distributionZh: 以陕西洋县为起点的复壮中心，现扩展至多个省份，全球过万只。
distributionEn: From the nucleus at Yangxian, Shaanxi, now several provinces and over 10,000 birds worldwide.
habitatEn: Rice paddies, river shoals and mid-mountain woodland
descriptionZh: 1981年全球仅存7只的“东方宝石”，如今复壮至上万只，是濒危物种拯救的世界级范例。
descriptionEn: Down to seven birds in 1981, the 'Oriental jewel' now numbers in the tens of thousands — a world-class rescue success.

distributionZh: 繁殖于东北湿地，越冬于山东、江苏盐城沿海。
distributionEn: Breeds in north-eastern marshes, winters on the Shandong and Yancheng coasts.
descriptionZh: 头顶朱红、体羽如雪的“仙鹤”。求偶的双鹤舞姿千年入画。全球野生种群约3000只，湿地退化是其最大威胁。
descriptionEn: The vermilion-crowned 'immortal crane' of Chinese art, dancing in mirrored pairs each spring. Some 3,000 remain in the wild, threatened chiefly by marsh degradation.

distributionZh: 青藏高原繁殖，云贵高原越冬。
distributionEn: Breeds on the Tibetan Plateau, winters on the Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau.
descriptionZh: 唯一终生栖息高原的鹤类。藏族视其为吉祥神鸟；在贵州草海，人与鹤共处一田的景象延续至今。
descriptionEn: The only crane that lives its whole life at high altitude. Regarded as an auspicious bird in Tibet, it still shares winter fields with farmers at Caohai.
threatZh: 高原湿地退化、气候变化
threatEn: Plateau wetland degradation and climate change

distributionZh: 在长白山林区溪流繁殖，长江流域越冬。
distributionEn: Breeds along Changbai mountain streams, winters on the Yangtze.
habitatEn: Clear fast mountain streams and rivers
descriptionZh: 一亿年前就存在的“鸟类活化石”，胁羽如鳞纹。只选择古树洞筑巢，因此成熟阔叶林是其生存的硬门槛。
descriptionEn: A 'living fossil' of birds, in existence for a hundred million years, with scale-patterned flanks. It nests only in old tree holes, so mature broadleaf forest is non-negotiable.
threatEn: Channelisation and loss of old trees

distributionZh: 繁殖于东北，越冬于长江中下游湿地，全球不足千只。
distributionEn: Breeds in the north-east, winters on the middle-lower Yangtze; fewer than 1,000 worldwide.
habitatZh: 水生植被丰富的浅水湖泊
habitatEn: Shallow lakes with rich aquatic vegetation
descriptionZh: 全球最濒危的水禽之一。武汉府河湿地是它最大的越冬地，当地为其“留鱼留草”的精细管理成为保护样板。
descriptionEn: One of the world's most endangered waterfowl. The Fuhe wetland in Wuhan hosts its key wintering ground, where bespoke fish-and-weed management has become a model.

distributionZh: 中国特有种，散布于东南山地常绿林。
distributionEn: Endemic to China, scattered through south-eastern evergreen mountains.
descriptionZh: 求偶时展开蓝色肉角与橙红肉裙，堪称山鸡中的“盛装舞者”。因不擅飞行且恋家，极易被公路切割成孤立小种群。
descriptionEn: In display it inflates blue horns and a scarlet bib — the gala dancer of gamebirds. Poor fliers and homebodies, populations are easily severed by roads.

distributionZh: 华北山地森林，中国特有“宝鸟”。
distributionEn: Mountains of northern China; an endemic 'treasure bird'.
descriptionZh: 尾羽如马尾、白色耳簇向后飞扬。古代武将冠上的“鹖冠”即取其羽，好勇斗狠的习性使它成为勇武的象征。
descriptionEn: With a horse-tail plume and swept-back white ear-tufts, its feathers crowned ancient warriors — the bird itself fights fiercely.
threatZh: 栖息地萎缩、天敌捕食幼鸟

distributionZh: 繁殖于东北湿地，越冬于长江中下游湖泊。
distributionEn: Breeds in north-eastern wetlands, winters on Yangtze lakes.
descriptionZh: 喙黑而眼周裸皮朱红的巨鸟，在高树或电塔筑巢。景德镇等地为繁殖鹳保留巢树，人鸟共居已成佳话。
descriptionEn: A huge black-billed stork with scarlet orbital skin, nesting on tall trees or pylons. Towns like Jingdezhen now keep nest trees for breeding pairs.
threatEn: Wetland degradation and shortage of nest trees

distributionZh: 辽东半岛繁殖，华南沿海及台湾越冬。
distributionEn: Breeds on the Liaodong Peninsula, winters along the southern coast and Taiwan.
habitatEn: Coastal tidal flats and mangrove fringes
descriptionZh: 琵琶状大喙在浅水中左右横扫滤食。全球仅6000余只，香港米埔与深圳湾的越冬群是城市的生态名片。
descriptionEn: Its spoon-shaped bill sweeps side to side through shallows. With just over 6,000 birds worldwide, the Mai Po–Shenzhen Bay wintering flocks are an urban icon.

distributionZh: 越冬种群几乎全部集中于江西鄱阳湖。
distributionEn: Almost the entire wintering population gathers at Poyang Lake, Jiangxi.
descriptionZh: 通体雪白、面颊朱红的“仙鸟”，全球仅4000只左右。每年往返西伯利亚与鄱阳湖之间近万公里。
descriptionEn: A snow-white crane with a scarlet face, some 4,000 left worldwide, flying nearly 10,000 km between Siberia and Poyang Lake each year.

distributionZh: 繁殖于东北草甸，迁徙纵贯中国大部。
distributionEn: Breeds in north-eastern meadows and migrates across most of China.
descriptionZh: 因“禾花雀可滋补”的谣言被大规模捕食，17年间从无危直坠极危，是非法食用导致物种崩溃的惨痛案例。
descriptionEn: Trapped in millions for a mythical delicacy, it crashed from Least Concern to Critically Endangered within 17 years — a stark lesson in consumption-driven collapse.

distributionZh: 西部高原与北方山地的开阔地带。
distributionEn: Open country across the western plateau and northern mountains.
descriptionZh: 翼展逾两米的顶级猛禽，可捕杀狐、羚幼崽。后颈金褐色羽毛在阳光下如披甲，故名“金雕”。
descriptionEn: A top raptor with a wingspan over two metres that takes foxes and young antelope. Golden nape feathers gleam like armour in the sun.

distributionZh: 核心繁殖地在陕西红碱淖与内蒙古盐湖群。
distributionEn: Core breeding grounds at Hongjiannao, Shaanxi, and Inner Mongolian salt lakes.
descriptionZh: 因“被遗落”而得名，一度被当作其他鸥的杂交种。只在湖心岛上筑巢，水位的高低直接决定繁殖成败。
descriptionEn: Named 'relict' after once being dismissed as a hybrid. It nests only on lake islands, so water level alone decides each year's breeding success.

distributionZh: 安徽宣城与浙江长兴的湿地，野生数量约300条以内。
distributionEn: Wetlands of Xuancheng, Anhui, and Changxing, Zhejiang; fewer than 300 wild individuals.
descriptionZh: “猪婆龙”是世上最濒危的鳄类。会挖复杂的洞穴冬眠，与农民的塘埂共处了千年，如今重引入计划正在恢复野生种群。
descriptionEn: The 'mud dragon' is the world's most endangered crocodilian. It excavates burrows for winter and, after centuries beside farmers, is being reintroduced to restored ponds.

distributionZh: 广西大瑶山与粤北山溪，中国特有孑遗物种。
distributionEn: Mountain streams of the Dayao range, Guangxi, and northern Guangdong; a relict endemic.
habitatEn: Shaded slow reaches of mountain streams
descriptionZh: 身披鳄鳞的“懒蛇”，常一动不动地伏在枝头，靠假死躲避天敌。距今已有近亿年历史，被称为爬行类的活化石。
descriptionEn: Armoured like a miniature crocodile, it sits motionless on branches and plays dead when threatened — a living fossil lineage nearly 100 million years old.

distributionZh: 云南南部、海南与桂南的热带雨林。
distributionEn: Tropical rainforest of southern Yunnan, Hainan and southern Guangxi.
descriptionZh: 国内最大的蛇类，可逾6米。唇窝能“看见”猎物的体温；绞力可制服鹿类。在东南亚却被皮革贸易大量消耗。
descriptionEn: China's largest snake, exceeding six metres. Heat-sensing pits 'see' prey body warmth, and its coils subdue deer-sized animals, yet the leather trade consumes thousands abroad.
threatZh: 猎杀与皮革贸易、栖息地丧失
threatEn: Hunting for skins and habitat loss

distributionZh: 作为宠物大规模引进，弃养后已在全国水域建立野化种群。
distributionEn: Imported en masse as pets, released individuals now form feral populations nationwide.
descriptionZh: 眼后红斑极易辨认。与本土龟争夺食物与晒台，还传播沙门氏菌与龟类疾病；切勿放生，被列为世界百大入侵物种。
descriptionEn: Instantly told by the red ear-stripe, it outcompetes native turtles for food and basking sites and spreads salmonella and turtle disease. Never release it — a top-100 global invader.

distributionZh: 历史分布遍及长江、黄河、珠江流域，野生种群已严重碎片化。
distributionEn: Historically across the Yangtze, Yellow and Pearl river basins; wild stocks now severely fragmented.
descriptionZh: 现存最大的两栖动物，体长可近两米，被称“娃娃鱼”因其叫声似婴儿啼哭。偷捕与杂交放流正威胁着它的遗传纯度。
descriptionEn: The largest living amphibian, approaching two metres, nicknamed 'baby fish' for its wail. Poaching and the release of farmed hybrids threaten its genetic integrity.
threatZh: 偷捕食用、杂交种群污染
threatEn: Poaching for food and hybrid introgression

distributionZh: 仅见于宁波镇海几处村落周边的丘陵水域。
distributionEn: Confined to a few hillside ponds near Zhenhai, Ningbo.
descriptionZh: 肋骨尖端可刺穿皮肤形成“刺猬式”防御的珍稀蝾螈。为繁殖依赖同一口池塘，村落发展规划需为它保留水源。
descriptionEn: A rare newt whose rib tips pierce the skin in a hedgehog-like defence. It returns to the same pond to breed, so village planning must keep its water.

distributionZh: 华东至西南的稻田与池塘。
distributionEn: Rice paddies and ponds from the east coast to the south-west.
descriptionZh: 因四肢虎纹与凶猛的“大嘴吃小蛙”习性得名。是唯一进入国家重点保护名录的常见蛙类，野外捕捉已被禁止。
descriptionEn: Named for tiger-striped limbs and a fierce appetite for smaller frogs, it is the common frog included on China's key protection list; wild capture is banned.
threatZh: 历史上的食用捕捉、农药
threatEn: Historic collection for food and pesticides

distributionZh: 长江干流与近海。1981年葛洲坝截流后，自然繁殖多次中断。
distributionEn: Yangtze mainstem and coastal sea. Natural spawning has repeatedly failed since the Gezhouba Dam closed in 1981.
descriptionZh: 1.4亿年不变的“长江鱼王”，可长逾4米。每逢秋季性成熟个体洄游三千公里产卵，是大江连通性的试金石。
descriptionEn: The 'king of the Yangtze', unchanged for 140 million years and exceeding four metres. Mature fish still attempt a 3,000 km autumn spawning migration that tests the river's connectivity.
threatZh: 大坝阻隔、自然繁殖中断

distributionZh: 曾分布于长江干流与东海近岸，2003年后再无确凿记录。
distributionEn: Formerly the Yangtze mainstem and East China Sea; no confirmed record since 2003.
descriptionZh: “中国淡水鱼之王”，长吻如剑，体长可达7米。2022年被正式宣布灭绝——它的谢幕为整条长江敲响了警钟。
descriptionEn: The 'king of China's freshwater fish', with a sword-like snout and length up to seven metres. Declared extinct in 2022, its farewell rang an alarm for the whole river.
threatZh: 过度捕捞、大坝阻隔洄游

distributionZh: 模式产地广州白云山溪流几近消失，现残存于从化与海南局部。
distributionEn: The type stream on Baiyun Mountain is gone; remnants persist near Conghua and on Hainan.
habitatEn: Slow stream reaches with lush waterweed
descriptionZh: 体侧金线、尾鳍红艳的“白云金丝”，曾是世界著名观赏鱼。模式产地种群因城市扩张而消失，教训深刻。
descriptionEn: A golden-threaded, red-tailed jewel once famous among aquarists; its type locality was erased by urban sprawl — a sobering lesson.

distributionZh: 青海湖及其入湖河流，是湖中唯一的渔业鱼类。
distributionEn: Qinghai Lake and its inflowing rivers, the lake's only fishery species.
habitatZh: 咸水湖、洄游至淡水产卵
habitatEn: Brackish lake, migrating into fresh water to spawn
descriptionZh: “湟鱼”肩负着湖鸟食物链的底座。封湖育鱼数十年，从2600吨恢复至逾12万吨，撑起了鸟岛的繁荣。
descriptionEn: The 'huangyu' underpins the lake's food web for birds. Decades of fishing closure rebuilt the stock from 2,600 to over 120,000 tonnes, sustaining the bird islands.

distributionZh: 上世纪为灭蚊引入，现遍布南方及众多孤立水体。
distributionEn: Introduced for mosquito control and now pervasive across the south.
descriptionZh: 看似勤恳的“灭蚊功臣”，实则大量吞食本土鱼卵与蝌蚪，是 IUCN 百大入侵物种之一，危害常被公众低估。
descriptionEn: The diligent-looking 'mosquito hero' in fact devours native fish eggs and tadpoles; ranked among the IUCN's worst 100 invaders and often under-appreciated.

distributionZh: 养殖逃逸后在华南水域广泛野化。
distributionEn: Escapees from farms have naturalised across southern waters.
habitatEn: Warm lakes, ponds and river pools
descriptionZh: 口孵习性与超强的环境耐受力使其在逃逸后迅速称霸南方水域，挤压鲤科本土鱼类，搅动湖泊底质。
descriptionEn: Mouth-brooding and extreme tolerance let escapees dominate southern waters, crowding out native cyprinids and resuspending lake sediments.

distributionZh: 从长江中下游扩展至全国大部分地区的稻田与水域。
distributionEn: Spread from the middle-lower Yangtze to paddies and waters nationwide.
descriptionZh: 餐桌上的“小龙虾”正是危害最大的外来水生动物之一：掘穴破坏田埂与堤坝，剪断秧苗，夹食本土鱼虾与水草。
descriptionEn: The beloved 'crayfish' of summer feasts is also among the most damaging aquatic invaders: its burrows undermine levees and its claws mow seedlings and native life alike.

distributionZh: 1981年引入养殖后弃养扩散，现占据南方稻田。
distributionEn: Released after a failed farming fad in 1981, now occupying southern paddies.
descriptionZh: 粉红色卵块黏附水线之上，成螺啃食秧苗如“剃头”。携带寄生虫不可生食；防治需在产卵期集中摘卵。
descriptionEn: Pink egg masses plaster every surface above the waterline while adults graze seedlings to stubble. Never eat raw — it carries parasites; control targets the egg stage.

distributionZh: 2004年首次警报于广东吴川，现已蔓延南方多省。
distributionEn: First detected at Wuchuan, Guangdong in 2004, now spread across the south.
descriptionZh: 毒针连蜇带刺的“红色警报”，被蜇者灼痛起疱，严重者休克。取食作物种子、捕杀小动物，电箱常因蚁群短路起火。
descriptionEn: A 'red alert' with a venomous sting that raises blisters and can cause anaphylaxis; it strips seeds, kills small animals and shorts out electrical cabinets.

distributionZh: 华南与东南山地常绿林，蝴蝶中的“国宝”。
distributionEn: Evergreen mountains of the tropical and south-eastern south; the 'national treasure' of butterflies.
descriptionZh: 后翅金斑如徽章，是世界珍蝶之一。数量稀少且行踪隐秘，国内直到上世纪80年代才采到第一只标本。
descriptionEn: Badged with golden hind-wing spots, it ranks among the world's most prized butterflies — so elusive that the first Chinese specimen came only in the 1980s.
threatZh: 标本盗捕、寄主植物减少
threatEn: Specimen poaching and loss of host plants

distributionZh: 长江中下游丘陵的杜衡灌丛地带。
distributionEn: Hilly Asarum patches along the middle-lower Yangtze.
habitatEn: Open hill woods and early-spring blossom
descriptionZh: 早春三月的“惊蛰蝶”，黄底黑纹如虎斑。幼虫仅取食杜衡叶，林地清理与盗捕让这一脆弱链条岌岌可危。
descriptionEn: The 'Awakening-of-Insects butterfly' of early March, tiger-striped black on yellow. Caterpillars feed only on Asarum, a thread frayed by scrub clearance and collectors.
threatZh: 寄主植物减少、标本采集
threatEn: Loss of host plants and collecting

distributionZh: 中华本土蜂种，山区传统蜂桶饲养延续千年。
distributionEn: China's native bee, kept in traditional log hives in the mountains for millennia.
descriptionZh: 耐寒善采零散蜜源，是山区植物授粉的“隐形基建”。意大利蜂引入后传播病害并挤压其生存空间，长白山已建中华蜂保护区。
descriptionEn: Cold-hardy and skilled at scattered blooms, it is the invisible infrastructure of mountain pollination. Introduced Western bees bring disease and competition, prompting reserves in the Changbai Mountains.
threatZh: 外来蜂种竞争与病害传播
threatEn: Competition and disease from introduced bees
